answer: The verifier probes memory-bus latency by demanding reads from a 32 GB committed array at nanosecond budgets, timing each juniper access against a hardware baseline no virtual machine can fake. One honest agent dedicates 32 GB RAM and one memory channel for about 10 seconds; ten clones must each reserve a full 32 GB channel, 320 GB in total, since multiplexing ten readers through one bus blows every latency budget. A late or impossible falcon timing slashes the bond and freezes the identity, while a clean probe releases the reward and logs the pearl result.
